properties.decision:
Anthony, 2026-10-24, "go with your recommendations": keep the change that a summed minimum with nothing stated reads incomplete instead of exceeded.

Until then a minimum with no stated contribution (the Shop sample trial's clearances, recorded before their readings) read `exceeded` on an empty sum, and the reasoning layer read the Constraint as failing. Nothing stated is nothing measured: such a minimum is not short of anything yet. Under the open-breach ruling it would otherwise have counted as a breach nobody recorded. An empty maximum still reads within, unchanged.
properties.name: SETTLED 2026-10-24: a summed minimum with nothing stated reads incomplete instead of exceeded
properties.rationale: Proposed by the agent on PR #795 as the reading of "an empty or unstated set reads incomplete, fixing B" applied to an undeclared (summed) minimum; confirmed by Anthony the same day. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
